sentence: This project brings together researchers at a conference about magnetic resonance imaging, a technology used to diagnose and study health conditions.
This project looks for ways other than antibiotics to prevent and treat bacterial infections.
This project studies how gene mutations change the activity of cortical neurons in epilepsy, using a human-derived model.
This project studies how a transcription factor shapes the growth of regulatory T cells from induced pluripotent stem cells.
This project tracks immune responses in cancer immunotherapy clinical trials to find biomarkers of response, resistance, and adverse events.
This project builds patient databases and registries and collects biospecimens to support research on food allergy.
This project builds tools to find insertions of a retrotransposon in the genome of normal human tissues, using long-read and single cell technologies.
This project builds a music-based platform of games and puzzles that aims to stimulate neuroplasticity in patients with Alzheimer's Disease.
This project builds methods to find genetic signs of natural selection in the human genome and what they mean for human diseases.
This project tries to develop antiviral drugs that patients can take orally against RNA viruses.
This project keeps genetic mouse models and measures their behavior and cognitive flexibility.
This project builds tools and web services that help researchers analyze molecules involved in cell-cell signaling, drug abuse, and pain perception.
This project studies how helicases and polymerases control immune responses and mitochondrial gene expression and replication.
This project studies how single neurons turn synaptic inputs into outputs and builds biophysical models of this process.
This project tries to find out how to get more neonatal intensive care units to use rapid whole genome sequencing.
This project studies malaria and other pathogens in children using genomics and serology, and tests interventions to reduce malaria.
This project aims to bring coherent fetal brain volumes and automated metrics into the radiology workflow.
This project studies how immune dysregulation arises and leads to autoimmunity and inflammation.
This project builds a low-cost method that uses machine learning to measure how diverse the T-cell receptors are.
This project studies how many genes and the environment interact to cause disease, using whole-genome sequencing in model organisms.
